items.sentence: Today, the pirates will abandon the old ship on the beach.

Today, the oak tree grew tall over one long decade.
Two classmates will establish a small garden club this spring.

One robot will assist the chef during the busy lunch.
Two classmates will resolve the puzzle before dinner time.
Students detect leaf changes and record them each morning.
Today, the blue team may defeat the red team in chess.
